title: Rust: Plugin System
description: Build a plugin system where plugins can be registered and executed at runtime.

steps.title: Define Plugin Trait
steps.description: Define a `Plugin` trait with methods `fn name(&self) -> &str` and `fn execute(&self, input: &str) -> String`. Implement `UpperCasePlugin` and `ReversePlugin`. Test both.
hints: Each plugin has a unique name.

steps.title: Plugin Registry
steps.description: Create a `PluginRegistry` that stores plugins in a `HashMap<String, Box<dyn Plugin>>`. Add methods `register(&mut self, plugin: Box<dyn Plugin>)` and `execute(&self, name: &str, input: &str) -> Option<String>`.
hints: `execute` looks up the plugin and calls its execute method.

verification.failureMessage: Register both plugins and execute them by name.

steps.title: Pipeline Execution
steps.description: Add a `run_pipeline(&self, plugin_names: &[&str], input: &str) -> String` method that runs multiple plugins sequentially, using each plugin's output as the next plugin's input.
hints: Start with `input`, iterate over plugin names.
Pipeline: UpperCase then Reverse on "hello" → "OLLEH" (reversed uppercase).

verification.failureMessage: Run UpperCase then Reverse on 'hello' to get 'OLLEH'.

steps.title: Plugin with Config
steps.description: Add a `PrefixPlugin` that takes a prefix string. Register multiple instances with different prefixes. Demonstrate the same plugin type with different configurations.
hints: `impl Plugin for PrefixPlugin { fn execute(&self, input: &str) -> String { format!("{}{}", self.prefix, input) } }`

verification.failureMessage: Create PrefixPlugin with 'Hello, ' and 'Bye, ' and execute both.

steps.title: Plugin with Dependencies
steps.description: Simulate plugin dependencies: a `StatsPlugin` that can be registered to collect statistics (execution count, average time). Track metrics from pipeline runs and print a report.
hints: Use `RefCell` or `Mutex` for interior mutability in plugin stats.
Print a stats report after executing the pipeline several times.

verification.failureMessage: Run the pipeline and print execution statistics.
